answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 11012 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum (1) i want to know about the explanation of my dream i so many times so that i was flying in the sky like an air-plane in the air (2) i also saw many times that i am unwillingly going upwards (as a gass filled balloon touches the roof if it is unthreaded in a room) and trying to come to the ground and asking others to help me. please help me know the ta-abeer Question: Assalamu alaikum (1) i want to know about the explanation of my dream i so many times so that i was flying in the sky like an air-plane in the air (2) i also saw many times that i am unwillingly going upwards (as a gass filled balloon touches the roof if it is unthreaded in a room) and trying to come to the ground and asking others to help me. please help me know the ta-abeer Answer ID: 11012 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 420/304=H/1430) (1, 2) Such dreams are seen due to infected substance in stomach. You should go to bed with wudhu as per the sunnah and decrease the quantity of dinner a little.
